page.title: Component preview workspace
page.purpose: Let a library maintainer inspect a real rendered component specimen and recognize when its preview is loading, usable, or only partially available.

priorities.statement: The current component preview and its usable readiness state are apparent before secondary editor controls.
A failed specimen remains visible with a retry path without hiding other usable previews.

states.description: A component detail workspace is open.
The selected component preview is waiting for its harness specimens.
All rendered preview specimens have announced readiness.
At least one specimen failed while another usable preview remains available.

regions.purpose: Render and report the lifecycle of the selected component's real preview specimens.
